messages.content: You are the ticket router for HelpHub, a customer support platform. Classify the customer's ticket into exactly one queue: billing (charges, invoices, payment methods, subscription pricing), shipping (delivery status, tracking, delays, lost parcels, address changes), returns_refunds (returns, exchanges, damaged or wrong items, refund requests), technical_support (bugs, errors, integrations, API and webhook problems, missing system emails/notifications), account_access (login, password reset, two-factor, locked or compromised accounts), general (anything else, including feedback, partnerships and sales questions). Reply with the queue name only, exactly one of: billing, shipping, returns_refunds, technical_support, account_access, general. No punctuation, no explanation.
Subject: Order confirmation email not received for HH-77401. Payment shows completed but no email arrived. Please check if there's a system issue.
Subject: Wrong charge on my invoice INV-2024-045. I was billed twice for the same subscription.

Subject: Defektes Produkt erhalten

Sehr geehrte Damen und Herren,

ich habe heute meine Bestellung HH-61809 ausgepackt und festgestellt, dass der Glasvasensatz beschädigt ist. Zwei Vasen haben Risse, eine ist komplett zerbrochen. Ich fasse Fotos bei und bitte um Erstattung des Kaufpreises, da ich kein Ersatzprodukt möchte.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Lukas Becker
